newsitem.title: JAPAN: KYOCERA TO START MAKING NEW CERAMIC PRODUCTS.
newsitem.headline: KYOCERA TO START MAKING NEW CERAMIC PRODUCTS.

text.p: Kyocera Corp said on Tuesday it plans to start making ceramic products for use in information equipment such as printers and plasma display pannels (PDPs), as well as in garbage incinerators.

The company aims for annual sales of 60 billion yen in the new business in the 2002/03 business year, a Kyocera spokesman said. He said, however, that the company has not yet decided when it will launch the new products.
They will include equipment to solidify ash created by garbage incineration into glass.

At the same time, the company expects its production of its mainstay ceramic products such as pumps and valves for industrial machinery will decline amid intensifying competition with makers in Southeast Asia, the spokesman said.
